name: Trademo Hermes for Claude
description: The Trade Intelligence MCP gives AI assistants seamless access to global trade intelligence, enabling them to discover buyers and suppliers, identify companies, retrieve comprehensive company trade profiles, search shipment-level import and export records, and analyze commodity trade flows across countries. With support for natural language queries and advanced trade filters such as HS codes, product keywords, countries, trade periods, ports, shipment value, and trading partners, it delivers trusted, structured trade intelligence in real time. Powered by Trademo's dataset of over 3 billion shipment records, 15 million company profiles, and coverage across 190+ countries, it enables AI applications to enrich company profiles, validate trading activity, analyze global markets, and generate actionable insights for sourcing, sales, procurement, and market research through a single, unified interface.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trademo Hermes for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trademo Hermes for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://trademo-gbs-mcp.trademo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trademo Hermes for Claude MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trademo Hermes for Claude provides these MCP tools: trademo_get_commodity_data, trademo_get_company_profile, trademo_get_credits, trademo_search_buyers, trademo_search_companies, trademo_search_sellers, and trademo_search_shipments.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trademo Hermes for Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trademo Hermes for Claude in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Trademo Hermes for Claude MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trademo Hermes for Claude requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Trademo Hermes for Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trademo Hermes for Claude is developed by Trademo Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
